identity: ONE original young woman archer, the Ember Archer, facing screen right in elevated three-quarter view. Preserve the bow size, the quiver, the costume and adult proportions.
plate: Locked orthographic camera, fixed anatomical scale and centred body. Keep the full head, bow, quiver, limbs and boots within frame. The background is perfectly flat saturated BLUE throughout, no gradients or changes of hue. No scenery, floor shadow, camera motion, zoom, additional weapons, magic, glow, particles or extra limbs. Both boots stay planted; the orange tunic tails stir gently. No walking, no drawing and no attack.
